parametric-second-derivatives-circle.alt: The unit circle x = cos t, y = sin t traced counterclockwise, its upper half in blue labelled concave down and its lower half in vermillion labelled concave up. Beside it: dy/dx = -cot t; the derivative of dy/dx with respect to t is csc squared t, positive for every t; dividing by dx/dt = -sin t gives the second derivative -1 over sin cubed t, negative on the upper half and positive on the lower half. Skipping the division by dx/dt would call the whole circle concave up.
